title: Do not overclaim one-shot evidence as multi-turn
question: multi-turn behavior
prompt: I need an acceptance claim that a skill remembers a decision across three turns. For this check you only have one-shot Pi JSON and must not use RPC or an interactive session. Can this run prove the claim? Report the evidence status and the next valid step.

assertions.rubric: The response must say one-shot evidence cannot prove multi-turn memory, label the result unsupported or reduced-fidelity, and name a stateful multi-turn execution such as Pi RPC as the next valid step.
